_comment: Zigbee device firmware Sensa has approved. Each entry is a Zigbee2MQTT OTA index entry (copied from https://github.com/Koenkk/zigbee-OTA index.json; the url plus sha512 pin the exact file) with one Sensa key added: sensa_model, the Zigbee2MQTT definition model the entry is offered to. Zigbee2MQTT is only ever asked against this list, so a device with no entry here is never offered an update. See docs/system-design/firmware-updates.md section 1.
